title: Internal: waiving an Auto Loans late charge caused by an autopay debit to a closed account
content:
# Internal: waiving an Auto Loans late charge caused by an autopay debit to a closed account

This entry of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies to a late charge on an auto loan installment that went unpaid because PCB presented the installment's autopay debit to a PCB checking account already closed, and the debit came back unpaid. Such a late charge is assessed contrary to the Auto Loans charter and is waived in full for bank error, as one fee waiver entry that names the late charge. The waiver is triggered by the state of the loan's records rather than by a borrower's request.

Observable effect for the borrower: the waiver and the reduced balances appear on the loan.

## Tool: waive_late_charge_e8055e73

**Situation of use and capability.** Waives in full, as a PCB bank-error correction, one late charge assessed on an installment of a borrower's auto loan. One call books a fee waiver entry on the loan's activity for the named late charge, with the waiver reason recorded as bank error and the fee code recorded as late charge. On the loan it lowers the unpaid fees by the waived amount less the part stated as applied to principal, and lowers the unpaid principal by that applied part (used only when the late charge had already been paid).

**How it is invoked.** An internal tool of the agent: it must first be unlocked with unlock_agent_discoverable_tool and then called with call_agent_discoverable_tool.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| customer_id | the customer reference number of the borrower, from the customer profile lookup | reference number |
| auto_loan_id | the auto loan reference number of the loan the late charge was assessed on, from the auto loan lookup | reference number |
| source_item_id | the reference number of the late charge entry being waived, as listed in the auto loan activity lookup | reference number |
| amount | the amount waived, equal to the whole late charge | USD, 2 decimal places |
| applied_to_principal | the part of the waived amount credited to principal because the late charge had already been paid | USD, 2 decimal places; 0.00 when it was still unpaid |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows status "waived" with: waiver_id (reference number of the new waiver entry), waived_fee_id (the late charge entry waived), amount (USD, 2 decimal places), and fees_due and principal_balance afterwards (USD, 2 decimal places).

## Basis Q&A

**Is this the same as a courtesy waiver?** No. It is a bank-error correction of a charge assessed contrary to the charter, recorded with the reason bank error.
